parameters.query:
with context as materialized (
  select
    '{{ $json.profile }}'::text as profile,
    '{{ $json.marketplace }}'::text as marketplace,
    {{ $json.dry_run ? 'true' : 'false' }}::boolean as dry_run,
    '{{ $json.target || "oferta.femininas" }}'::text as target,
    '{{ $json.run_id || "instagram-manual" }}'::text as run_id,
    nullif('{{ $json.instagram_business_account_id || "" }}', '')::text as instagram_business_account_id,
    nullif('{{ $json.whatsapp_group_url || "" }}', '')::text as whatsapp_group_url
), confirmed as materialized (
  select count(*) as instagram_confirmed
  from offers.publication_events
  where delivery_status = 'confirmed'
    and channel_adapter in ('instagram_reels', 'instagram_carousel')
    and sent_at >= ((now() at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date::timestamp at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo')
    and sent_at < ((((now() at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date + 1)::timestamp) at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo')
), next_format as materialized (
  select 'reels'::text as instagram_format
  from confirmed
  where instagram_confirmed < 6
)
select
  plan.dispatch_plan_id, plan.profile, plan.marketplace, plan.stable_key, plan.item_id,
  coalesce(snapshot.product_name, catalog.product_name) as product_name,
  coalesce(snapshot.offer_link, catalog.offer_link) as offer_link,
  coalesce(snapshot.price, catalog.price) as price,
  coalesce(snapshot.rating, catalog.rating) as rating,
  plan.primary_subniche, plan.selection_bucket, plan.selection_reason,
  media.product_link, media.shop_id, media.image_urls, media.video_url,
  media.resolved_at as media_resolved_at, media.last_checked_at as media_last_checked_at,
  expected.instagram_format, plan.planned_date, plan.planned_hour, plan.slot_sequence, plan.daily_sequence,
  plan.created_at as planned_at, ctx.dry_run, ctx.target, ctx.run_id,
  ctx.instagram_business_account_id, ctx.whatsapp_group_url,
  case when ctx.dry_run then 'cancelled' else 'confirmed' end as delivery_status
from context ctx
cross join next_format expected
join offers.daily_dispatch_plan plan
  on plan.profile = ctx.profile
 and plan.marketplace = ctx.marketplace
 and plan.planned_date = (now() at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date
join offers.offer_media_assets media
  on media.profile = plan.profile
 and media.marketplace = plan.marketplace
 and media.item_id = plan.item_id
join lateral (
  select c.product_name, c.offer_link, c.price, c.rating
  from offers.catalog_items c
  where c.profile = plan.profile and c.marketplace = plan.marketplace and c.stable_key = plan.stable_key
  order by c.created_at desc
  limit 1
) catalog on true
left join lateral (
  select s.product_name, s.offer_link, s.price, s.rating
  from offers.offer_snapshots s
  where s.marketplace = plan.marketplace and s.item_id = plan.item_id
  order by s.checked_at desc
  limit 1
) snapshot on true
where media.status = 'valid'
  and media.video_url is not null
  and not exists (
    select 1 from offers.publication_events event
    where event.delivery_status = 'confirmed'
      and event.channel_adapter in ('instagram_reels', 'instagram_carousel')
      and event.payload ->> 'source_dispatch_plan_id' = plan.dispatch_plan_id::text
      and event.payload ->> 'dry_run' = 'false'
  )
order by plan.daily_sequence
limit 1
for update of plan skip locked;

nodes.notes: Seleciona diretamente do plano diario + midia + fontes comerciais leves; preserva SKIP LOCKED sem recalcular v_offer_ranking_current dentro do lock.

parameters.query:
update offers.offer_media_assets
set status = 'stale',
    last_checked_at = now(),
    error_detail = 'media_revalidation_failed'
where profile = '{{ $json.profile }}'
  and marketplace = '{{ $json.marketplace }}'
  and item_id = {{ $json.item_id }};

insert into offers.publication_events (
  dispatch_plan_id, profile, marketplace, stable_key, item_id,
  target, channel_adapter, delivery_status, manifest_item_number,
  artifact_generated_at, manifest_created_at, planned_at, sent_at,
  offer_title, offer_url, offer_price, message_text, payload
)
values (
  null::uuid,
  '{{ $json.profile }}',
  '{{ $json.marketplace }}',
  '{{ $json.stable_key }}',
  {{ $json.item_id }},
  '{{ $json.target || "oferta.femininas" }}',
  'instagram_reels',
  '{{ $json.delivery_status || "cancelled" }}',
  coalesce({{ $json.daily_sequence }}, 1),
  now(), now(), '{{ $json.planned_at }}'::timestamptz,
  case when '{{ $json.delivery_status }}' = 'confirmed' then now() else null end,
  '{{ $json.product_name }}', '{{ $json.offer_link }}', {{ $json.price || 'null' }}, '{{ $json.caption_base }}',
  jsonb_build_object(
    'run_id', '{{ $json.run_id }}',
    'dry_run', {{ $json.dry_run ? 'true' : 'false' }},
    'source_dispatch_plan_id', '{{ $json.dispatch_plan_id }}',
    'instagram_format', '{{ $json.instagram_format }}',
    'media_validation', '{{ JSON.stringify($json.media_validation || []) }}'::jsonb,
    'blocked_reason', '{{ $json.blocked_reason || "" }}',
    'container_status', '{{ $json.container_status || "" }}',
    'container_id', '{{ $json.creation_id || "" }}',
    'published_media_id', '{{ $json.instagram_media_id || "" }}'
    'template_id', coalesce({{ $json.template_id || 'null' }}, null),
    'ass_asset_version', '{{ $json.ass_asset_version || "" }}',
    'render_status', '{{ $json.render_status || "not_attempted" }}',
    'render_attempts', coalesce({{ $json.render_attempts || 0 }}, 0),
    'render_error_code', '{{ $json.render_error_code || "" }}',
    'render_error_log', '{{ $json.render_error_log || "" }}',
    'overlay_applied', coalesce({{ $json.overlay_applied ? 'true' : 'false' }}, false),
    'published_video_source', '{{ $json.published_video_source || "shopee_original" }}'
  )
)
on conflict (channel_adapter, ((payload ->> 'source_dispatch_plan_id')))
where channel_adapter in ('instagram_reels', 'instagram_carousel')
  and payload ? 'source_dispatch_plan_id'
  and payload ->> 'dry_run' = 'false'
do update
set delivery_status = excluded.delivery_status, sent_at = excluded.sent_at, message_text = excluded.message_text, payload = excluded.payload, updated_at = now()
returning publish_id;
